name: Mika Black
home: the streets inland from Pier Beach
life: “I still remember labels changing colors after several washes.” People around the public end of the South Shore boardwalk know Mika by a small Friday habit. Mika checks the shade on the benches before deciding how long to stay.
voice: I mistook its red tie for an allergy marker. I promised to make a label that explains the joke.
appearance: Mika has a strong profile and a little space between the front teeth. Look for a blunt cut just below the ears. Out of work clothes, the familiar outfit is a long navy raincoat with a folded shopping list secured by a miniature clip. In conversation Mika folds a paper napkin into quarters without noticing.
personality: Mika is firm about boundaries and unusually forgiving of somebody who admits to crossing one. Demands to act grateful for unwanted help can end a friendship.
agenda: To replace the misleading red tie label.
family: Fern Gillen is Mika’s cousin. Mika chooses the music. Fern puts the kettle on. The cups come out before either brings up the reason for the visit. They trust a difficult conversation more if it has had an ordinary beginning. Asked about *The empty berth*, Fern says, “I know the four boats by the noises their owners leave behind.”
connections: Talia Drew. They put the watering information on the repaired stand.

reactions.situation: A patient asks to be alone with the plant
reactions.response: Mika leaves the patient with the plant and returns at an agreed time.

reactions.situation: A coworker arrives late after a night at the hospital
reactions.response: Mika writes down the shift time accurately, then helps them explain the circumstances without having to tell the whole room.

reactions.situation: If a relative arrives with a solution nobody requested
reactions.response: Mika thanks them for coming and explains the part that still belongs to the household.
